name: Yami Starter
generation: Built-in image_gen tool; generated at 1536x1024 and exported as 1920x1280 high-quality JPEGs with bicubic resampling.
rights: Generated for Yami. Included with the project's MIT distribution to the extent copyright applies; no third-party artwork, characters, logos or reference images were used.
promptTemplate: Original soothing painterly Japanese environmental desktop landscape, 3:2, no humans, characters, creatures, text, logos, borders or watermark.

wallpapers.name: moonlit fuji
wallpapers.scene: A distant Japanese volcanic mountain above a still lake at blue hour, slender moon and a mist bank, indigo and cool silver. Sparse reeds in the near foreground, generous calm sky.

wallpapers.name: rainy kyoto
wallpapers.scene: An empty narrow Kyoto lane after gentle rain at dusk, wooden machiya facades, muted amber paper lantern glow reflecting in stone pavement, soft blue air, no readable signs.

wallpapers.name: bamboo whisper
wallpapers.scene: An immersive Japanese bamboo grove in morning mist, tall jade stalks and pale shafts of light, an empty moss path receding gently, hand-painted layered depth.

wallpapers.name: sakura river
wallpapers.scene: A quiet river beneath arching cherry blossoms in the Japanese countryside at early dawn, blush petals on dark turquoise water, pale apricot horizon, a tiny distant footbridge with nobody on it.

wallpapers.name: snowy onsen
wallpapers.scene: An empty outdoor Japanese stone hot spring in a snowy cedar valley, blue twilight, warm steam and a softly illuminated timber shelter, tranquil winter composition.

wallpapers.name: coastal torii
wallpapers.scene: A solitary vermilion torii on a quiet rocky Japanese coast under a pastel lavender sunset, glassy tidal water and broad hazy horizon, restrained color and expansive breathing room.

wallpapers.name: moss garden
wallpapers.scene: A peaceful Japanese moss garden after rain, rounded stones and a small stone lantern beneath deep maple shade, warm flecks of afternoon sun, fern textures, contemplative green palette.

wallpapers.name: autumn terraces
wallpapers.scene: Rolling Japanese mountain rice terraces in late autumn, copper maples and gold grasses, distant layered violet mountains under thin cloud, an empty winding path, broad painterly scenic view.

wallpapers.name: starry ridge
wallpapers.scene: An empty Japanese alpine ridge beneath a clear star-filled night, luminous Milky Way very softly painted, distant valley lights, silhouettes of pines and deep navy mountains, soothing dark wallpaper.

wallpapers.name: floating islands
wallpapers.scene: Dreamlike small forested Japanese islands on a vast misty inland sea at sunrise, pale jade water and soft peach clouds, a distant wooden shrine roof partly hidden in trees, quiet atmospheric landscape.
